ana: FYI - customer Atlas wants a compact observability slice for Dedicated: per-route econ, simple trace hooks, and error alerts. They need a demoable alpha in 10 days.

mike: OK. Scope suggestion: route-level cost (est $/hr, $/100k tokens), pre-aggregated hourly. Trace: sampling toggle + recent spans modal (metadata only). Alerts: error-rate rule + link to traces.

sophia: UX: inline estimated cost on route list, tiny traces icon -> modal with span rows and a "fetch full span" button. Tooltips explaining sampling. Two-phase: alpha (table+modal+alert), beta (time series & trace viewer).

jeff: Ops: metadata-only sampling much cheaper. Estimate for Atlas at 1% ~= 22GB/week. Need opt-in for Private and KMS check. Canary plan required.

mike: Alpha tasks: 1) cost aggregator job + schema, 2) trace sampler flag + forwarder that emits metadata, 3) UI table + modal + sampling toggle, 4) alert wiring. Rough 3 dev-weeks.

sophia: Acceptance criteria (alpha): filterable cost table by model/team, per-customer sampling toggle, recent spans modal with fetch-on-demand, alert template, RBAC & audit logs.

ana: Canary plan: enable for 10% traffic for 24h. Rollback if trace backlog >45m or cost delta vs billing >5% for 30m. SLA for cost latency <5m. Sales wants a one-pager tomorrow.

jeff: I'll add storage/cost calc and encryption checklist to the ticket.

ops-bot: Created ticket RED-7102: "Atlas: per-route econ + traces (alpha)" - https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-7102

mike: Will draft API schema today and share.

ana: Thanks all — will collect notes and draft the sales brief.
